sloka: अप्रविष्टं च भवनं युद्धाय पुरुषर्षभ ।आह्वयेथा महाबाहो ततो हन्तासि राक्षसम् ।। ७.६३.२९ ॥
transliteration: apraviṣṭaṁ ca bhavanaṁ yuddhāya puruṣarṣabha ।āhvayethā mahābāho tato hantāsi rākṣasam ।। 7.63.29 ॥

translations.english: O best among men, O mighty-armed one, you should challenge him for battle before he enters his dwelling, and then you will be able to kill the demon.
